basis: Apple iOS 27 / HIG Motion; Peopi custom values, not Apple system constants

spring.use: native selection and sheets; interruptible, minimal overshoot

principles: State commits immediately; motion never delays or grants authorization.
Cancel/retarget on repeated actions; preserve tab state and scroll.
Animate groups, never individual letters or every list item.
Reduce Motion replaces travel/scale with short opacity feedback.
Glass belongs to navigation and controls; keep text readable.
